exactIssue: Is HOLD a fourth overall traffic value, a required directive, or a separate terminalization gate when owner source is missing?

relevantRule.excerpt: SOURCE_MISSING fails closed for root completion/release while allowing safe reversible contributing work where valid.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: Implementations can emit incompatible GREEN/YELLOW/RED/UNKNOWN/HOLD values and clients may accidentally treat HOLD as ordinary YELLOW progress rather than a terminalization prohibition.
proposedChange: Use overall traffic GREEN | YELLOW | RED | UNKNOWN; model HOLD as a separate required directive/terminalization gate. SOURCE_MISSING projects UNKNOWN unless another deterministic RED condition applies, and rootTerminalizationAllowed remains false.
alternativesConsidered: Add HOLD to the traffic enum
risks: UNKNOWN can look passive unless the HOLD directive and source-missing reason are visually prominent
workerRecommendation: Keep traffic evidence and workflow directive as separate machine fields.
workerUncertainty: Current prose uses HOLD both colloquially and as an apparent state label without one canonical enum declaration.
decisionThatCanChange: The public projection schema and SOURCE_MISSING UI behavior.
